items.title: Has Nepal gained climate justice, or compromised its bigger claim?
items.summary: It has been two months since the devastating floods in the Bhotekoshi River. In the meantime, we have also witnessed landslides and floods in the Budhi Gandaki region. The effects of the glacial tsunamis triggered by the climate crisis remain just as severe. Against this backdrop, Prime Minister Balen Shah’s appeal for climate justice at […] The post Has Nepal gained climate justice, or compromise

items.title: No bridge, no market: Vegetables rot in fields after Bhotekoshi floods
items.summary: Farmers in Rasuwa’s Aamachhodingmo struggle to sell their produce as damaged roads, costly transport and the lack of a bridge at Syafrubesi leave millions of rupees’ worth of vegetables stranded.

items.title: Nepal plans temporary bridges to reopen flood-hit Rasuwagadhi border crossing
items.summary: Authorities aim to restore road access to the Chinese border before rebuilding permanently, while also considering an expressway to Kerung in place of a proposed railway.
